text.p: Internacional de Ceramica SA said on Thursday it obtained a 1996 net profit of 94.3 million pesos compared to a loss of 233 million pesos the previous year.
The company, which makes tiles, said its 1996 sales totalled a record 1.289 billion pesos, up some 22.65 percent compared to 1995 levels.
The company said its operating performance also registered a turnaround. It had 1996 operating profits of 88.3 million pesos compared to operating losses of 17.1 million in 1995.
"1996 was an important year for the company, which showed important signs of a turnaround along with the Mexican economy," the company said in a statement through the Mexican Bolsa.
Because no new factories were built, our efforts were focused on integrating the new plants dedicated to wall tiles, and adjusting our franchise system," it added.
The firm said the fourth quarter of last year was the second quarter in a row that it was able to raise its domestic prices in real terms.
Export sales were up 41 percent compared to 1995 levels, the company said.
It added that its 1997 goals were to make its plant in Garland, Texas efficient and improve operations at the rest of its plants by obtaining a better product mix.
